notes.id: Dana pengembangan (uang pangkal) dan dana pendidikan dibayar satu kali selama di jenjang tersebut; dana pendidikan termasuk sarana dan bahan ajar tahun pertama. notes.en: The development fund (entry fee) and education fund are paid once per school level; the education fund covers first-year facilities and learning materials. period.id: Pendaftaran online dibuka 8 Agustus 2026. Siswa dari luar Nurul Fikri: gelombang I seleksi 17 Oktober 2026; gelombang II seleksi 14 November 2026 (pengumuman 26 November); gelombang III seleksi 5 Desember 2026 (pengumuman 17 Desember). Gelombang II dan III hanya dibuka jika kuota masih tersedia.
period.en: Online registration opened 8 August 2026. External applicants: wave I selection 17 October 2026; wave II selection 14 November 2026 (results 26 November); wave III selection 5 December 2026 (results 17 December). Waves II and III open only if places remain.

steps.en: Register online at ppdb.nurulfikri.sch.id.
Pay the registration fee.

steps.id: Unggah dokumen maksimal 5 hari setelah pembayaran.
steps.en: Upload documents within 5 days of payment.
Attend the selection on the scheduled date (in person).

steps.id: Pengumuman hasil, lalu daftar ulang dengan membayar biaya pendidikan.
steps.en: Results are announced; then re-register by paying the education fees.

documents.en: Scan of the family card (Kartu Keluarga)

test.id: Observasi (dibantu psikolog) dan wawancara orang tua.
test.en: Observation (with a psychologist) and parent interview.

notes.id: Usia: PG lahir Juli 2023–Juni 2024; TK A lahir Juli 2022–Juni 2023; TK B lahir Juli 2021–Juni 2022.
notes.en: Age: Playgroup born July 2023–June 2024; TK A born July 2022–June 2023; TK B born July 2021–June 2022.
